changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A workspace keeps its practices in at most one monitored repository, its practice repository (ADR 0118).

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A practice is edited in Hephaestus or in the practice repository; the repository then owns its definition and group (ADR 0118).
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE practice ADD CONSTRAINT ck_practice_edited_in CHECK (edited_in IN ('HEPHAESTUS','REPOSITORY'));

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE practice DROP CONSTRAINT ck_practice_edited_in;

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The commit of the practice repository that a version's definition was read at; null for a version edited in Hephaestus.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The configuration audit records changes to the practice repository.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE config_audit_event DROP CONSTRAINT ck_config_audit_event_entity_type; ALTER TABLE config_audit_event ADD CONSTRAINT ck_config_audit_event_entity_type CHECK (entity_type IN ('PROVIDER_RESOURCE_RELEASE', 'PRACTICE_REVIEW_SETTINGS', 'MODEL_ASSIGNMENT', 'AGENT_BINDING', 'AGENT_CONFIG', 'AI_CONFIG_BINDING', 'WORKSPACE_ROLE', 'ACTIVITY_AUTOMATION', 'WORKSPACE_FEATURES', 'WORKSPACE_STATUS', 'WORKSPACE_TOKEN', 'WORKSPACE_VISIBILITY', 'PRACTICE_ACTIVE', 'PRACTICE_USAGE', 'PRACTICE_DEFINITION', 'PRACTICE_GROUP', 'PRACTICE_REPOSITORY', 'CATALOG_PRACTICE', 'CATALOG_GROUP', 'WORKSPACE_INSTANCE_LLM_BUDGET', 'WORKSPACE_OWN_PROVIDER_LLM_BUDGET', 'WORKSPACE_LLM_BUDGET', 'WORKSPACE_BYO_LLM_BUDGET', 'REVIEW_BATCH', 'REVIEW_SCHEDULE', 'FEEDBACK_DELIVERY_RECHECK', 'WORKSPACE_LLM_CONNECTION', 'WORKSPACE_LLM_MODEL'));
